meta.name: digital-avatar-shopping-video
meta.description: 电商运营与自媒体创作者在需要制作商品推荐或促销带货短视频时，使用此技能可一键生成“小省导购员”数字人口播视频。系统自动协同五大智能体完成脚本、画面与音画合成，产出适配抖音、快手等平台的成品，高效搞定带货视频制作。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入商品信息，自动产出数字人带货短视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你做电商或自媒体，需要快速生成商品推荐视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn product info into ready-to-post avatar shopping videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create product promo videos regularly for e-commerce or social media

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按五大智能体流程把商品需求变成「小省导购员」数字人口播带货视频:先对接需求并核查知识库,再写口播脚本、生成口播音频、设计动态画面,最后合成带字幕与背景音乐的 9:16 竖屏 MP4。
howto.when: 当你需要生成带货视频、产品推荐视频或价格对比视频等,或要做购物咨询类短视频时触发。

say.text: 帮我推荐3款2000-3000元的性价比手机,做一条60秒带货视频
say.note: 先查知识库,再按五步流程生成

say.text: 对比京东和淘宝的Nike男鞋价格,做成45秒竖屏对比视频
618大促推荐爆款家电,做一条90秒促销口播视频

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a five-agent flow to make a 小省导购员 digital-avatar shopping video: it checks the knowledge base, writes the script, generates voiceover and motion visuals, then outputs a subtitled 9:16 MP4 with BGM.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a product-selling video, product recommendation video, price-comparison video or shopping-consultation video.

say_en.text: Recommend 3 phones under 3000 yuan and make a 60-second shopping video
say_en.note: Checks the knowledge base, then runs all five agents

say_en.text: Compare Nike men's shoe prices on JD and Taobao as a 45-second vertical video
say_en.note: Outputs a split-screen MP4 with both prices

say_en.text: Make a 90-second 618 promo video for top-selling home appliances
say_en.note: Archives the result for reuse on similar requests
